Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Linear Distressed Wool Area Rug, 8 x 10 Foot, Grey
Colors: Grey
Materials: 80% Wool 20% Cotton
80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported The muted tones in this pure wool, hand-tufted rug allow it to easily blend in with your existing décor. The muted grey details add an element of exciting visual texture. Distressed linear pattern Wool and cotton fibers hand-tufted in India Low, 0.3" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 8' x 10' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
